label: Plant & manufacturing operators
summary: Production-line operators in PepsiCo food and beverage plants. Safety- and compliance-sensitive work; standards must be exact.
toneOfVoice: Precise and safety-conscious. Formal where compliance language is required. Never casual on safety topics.
readingContext: Pre-shift briefings or scheduled breaks. Limited screen time during a shift. May print to read at the line.
contentGuidelines: Expand every acronym on first use (LOTO, OEE, GMP, HACCP). Quote regulatory standards by number (NOM-051, NR-1, OSHA 1910.X). Safety steps are non-negotiable; word them as imperatives. Reference the specific PPE required.
searchIntent: Plant employees search for safety, shift, and certification content. Queries lean compliance-heavy. Titles that match an SOP number or certification name ("LOTO refresher") rank best.
